operative_clauses.judgment_reason: EO 10964 of September 20, 1961 (26 FR 8932, held Federal Register text; no deferred effective date, signed September 20, 1961) deleted paragraph (i) of section 4 of EO 10501 (the lettered paragraph this clause added) and inserted different paragraphs in its place. The text this clause inserted into EO 10501 was therefore no longer in force after 1961-09-20, a first end by later presidential replacement of the amended text (the amended parent order continued until EO 11652). The Federal Register copy printed in the held text carries the order's section 4 and section 8 changes in its paragraphs 1 and 4.

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: Section 14 of EO 11652 of March 8, 1972 (37 FR 5209, held Federal Register text) provides that Executive Order No. 10501 of November 5, 1953, as amended by Executive Orders No. 10816 and the other listed amending orders, "is superseded as of the effective date of this order." Section 15 of EO 11652 states that it "shall become effective on June 1," 1972. EO 10816 only amended EO 10501 and its text was part of EO 10501 as amended, so it ended when the parent order was superseded. The amendment in paragraph 2 (adds the Historical Research access subparagraph to section 15 of EO 10501) therefore ended on 1972-06-01 by presidential express supersession of the parent order (inclusive reading: the instrument speaks of the effective date, 1972-06-01, so the amendment was operative through May 31, 1972).

research_rationale:
EO 10816 (24 FR 3777, signed May 7, 1959; held official Federal Register text) amended Executive Order No. 10501 of November 5, 1953 (safeguarding official information) in three paragraphs: a new subparagraph of section 4, a new Historical Research subparagraph of section 15, and a restated first sentence of section 8(d). EO 11652 section 14 supersedes EO 10501 as amended by EO 10816 and the other listed amending orders as of its effective date, and section 15 makes it effective June 1, 1972, so clause 2 (the Historical Research subparagraph) ended on 1972-06-01; clauses 1 and 3 ended earlier, on 1961-09-20, when EO 10964 replaced their text (see below). The whole-order end is therefore 1972-06-01, and the order was not in force on 2026-10-14. The inventory is corrected (paragraph 1 had been omitted). EO 11652 itself describes EO 10816 as of May 8, 1959, the filing date, while the register signing date is May 7, 1959; the same instrument is meant. EO 10964 (September 20, 1961, held Federal Register text) deleted paragraph (i) of section 4 of EO 10501 and inserted different paragraphs (ending clause 1's text), and in its paragraph 4 restated paragraphs (c) and (d) of section 8 in full (replacing the sentence restated by clause 3); those are first ends of clauses 1 and 3.
